summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2019-2022 Veloster N, 2019-2023 Kona Electric vehicles. A software error in the air bag control unit (ACU) may improperly deactivate the air bag system and seat belt pretensioners.

title: Ford Motor Company: Windshield Wipers May Detach (330 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2026 Bronco vehicles. A wiper arm nut on the driver-side may loosen, causing the windshield wipers to detach.

title: Ford Motor Company: Loose 12-Volt Cable May Cause Loss of Drive Power (8,650 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022 Maverick Hybrid vehicles. The 12V positive battery cable terminal may become loose or detach, which can cause a loss of electrical systems (including power steering assist, power brake assist, and exterior lighting) or a loss of drive power.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Incorrect High Voltage Battery Charging Software (286 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2027 i7 50xDrive, i7 60xDrive, 2026-2027 i5 xDrive40, i5 eDrive40, and i5 M60 vehicles. The high voltage battery charging software may be incorrect.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: Driveline May Separate (982 affected)
summary: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2027 Kenworth T280, T380, T680, T880, and W990 vehicles. The drivelines may be missing a snap ring in the slip yoke assembly, causing the bearing cup to separate from the driveline.

title: Hendrickson USA. L.L.C.: Front Steer Axle Huck Pins May Detach (14,238 affected)
summary: Hendrickson USA. L.L.C. (Hendrickson) is recalling certain STEERTEK NXT front steer axle assemblies. The huck collars may not have been properly connected to the mating pins.

title: Shyft Group: Information Missing from the Tire and Loading Label/FMVSS 110 (4,399 affected)
summary: Shyft Group (Shyft) is recalling certain 2017, 2020-2026 Utilimaster Upfit vehicles. The tire and loading label may not list the combined weight value. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard Number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Unexpected Loss of Brake Pressure (14,648 affected)
summary: Acura (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2024 Acura ZDX vehicles equipped with all-wheel drive. A software error may unexpectedly activate the anti-lock brake system (ABS) and release brake pressure.

title: Lamar Trailers, Inc.: Spare Tire May Detach From Trailer (8,407 affected)
summary: Lamar Trailers, Inc (Lamar Trailers) is recalling certain 2021-2027 gooseneck trailers. The spare tire may be improperly secured, allowing the spare tire to detach.
